desired_performances: Given a monitoring dashboard, interpret degradation signals, differentiate likely causes, and propose a response action.

objectives.performance: interpret degradation signals on a monitoring dashboard
conditions: given a monitoring dashboard with performance metrics
success_criteria: correctly identifies degradation signals present in the dashboard
describes the nature of each signal (e.g., accuracy drop, latency increase, drift)

assumption_notes: assumes learner has basic familiarity with monitoring dashboard interfaces
assumes common degradation signals include metrics like accuracy, latency, throughput, error rate, and drift

objectives.performance: differentiate likely causes of observed degradation
conditions: given interpreted degradation signals from a monitoring dashboard
success_criteria: distinguishes between multiple plausible root causes
provides reasoning for why each cause is likely or unlikely based on signal patterns

assumption_notes: assumes learner can reason about causal relationships between system changes and degradation
candidate causes may include data drift, model staleness, infrastructure changes, upstream service degradation

objectives.performance: propose a response action to address model degradation
conditions: given interpreted signals and differentiated likely causes
success_criteria: justifies the response based on the identified cause
considers trade-offs or constraints in the proposed action

assumption_notes: assumes learner has awareness of common response actions such as retraining, rollback, alerting, data pipeline investigation
response quality depends on understanding operational context not specified in brief

assessments.capability_claim: Learner can interpret degradation signals on a monitoring dashboard

required_evidence.criterion: Correctly identifies at least three distinct degradation signals present in the dashboard
required_evidence.rationale: Demonstrates ability to recognize signal patterns indicating performance issues

required_evidence.criterion: Accurately describes the nature of each identified signal using appropriate terminology
required_evidence.rationale: Shows conceptual understanding of what each signal represents

task.description: Examine a monitoring dashboard fixture displaying multiple performance metrics over time. Identify all degradation signals present and describe the nature of each signal.
conditions: dashboard displays at least 5 distinct metrics
time series data spans sufficient period to show signal trends
no explanatory annotations are provided on the dashboard

performance_levels: Identifies fewer than 2 signals
Identifies 2 signals with partial accuracy
Identifies 3+ signals with high accuracy
Descriptions are vague or incorrect
Descriptions are partially accurate with some terminology errors
Descriptions are precise and use appropriate technical terminology

scoring.mastery_rule: Both dimensions must reach highest level

assumption_notes: assumes dashboard fixture can be created with known degradation signals
assumes learner response can be evaluated against ground truth signal inventory
does not verify ability to prioritize signals by severity

assessments.capability_claim: Learner can differentiate likely causes of observed model degradation

required_evidence.criterion: Proposes at least two distinct plausible root causes
Provides evidence-based reasoning that connects signal patterns to each proposed cause
required_evidence.rationale: Shows ability to reason from observations to hypotheses

required_evidence.criterion: Distinguishes relative likelihood among proposed causes using signal characteristics
required_evidence.rationale: Demonstrates analytical differentiation rather than listing possibilities

task.description: Given a set of interpreted degradation signals from a monitoring dashboard, identify multiple plausible root causes and explain which cause is most likely based on the signal patterns. Provide reasoning for each cause considered.
conditions: signals are provided as interpreted data (learner does not re-interpret raw dashboard)
signal set is consistent with at least two distinct root causes
no direct information about recent system changes is provided

performance_levels: Proposes only one cause
Proposes two causes but with weak differentiation
Proposes multiple causes with clear distinctions
Reasoning is absent or disconnected from signals
Reasoning references signals but connections are weak or incomplete
Reasoning clearly links signal patterns to causal mechanisms

scoring.mastery_rule: Both dimensions must reach highest level

assumption_notes: assumes signal patterns can be designed to admit multiple plausible causes
assumes learner has conceptual knowledge of common degradation causes not explicitly taught in this brief
does not assess ability to gather additional diagnostic information

assessments.capability_claim: Learner can propose an appropriate response action to address identified model degradation

required_evidence.criterion: Proposes a specific, actionable response that directly addresses the identified most-likely cause
required_evidence.rationale: Demonstrates procedural knowledge of response actions

required_evidence.criterion: Justifies the proposed response by connecting it to the causal analysis
required_evidence.rationale: Shows coherent reasoning from diagnosis to intervention

required_evidence.criterion: Acknowledges at least one trade-off or constraint relevant to the proposed action
required_evidence.rationale: Demonstrates evaluative judgment about response appropriateness

task.description: Given interpreted signals and your analysis of likely causes, propose a specific response action to address the model degradation. Justify your proposal by connecting it to your causal analysis and discuss at least one trade-off or constraint.
conditions: builds on learner's own causal analysis from prior task
no organizational or operational context constraints are specified
learner must make reasonable assumptions about available response options

rubric_dimensions.criterion: Specificity and actionability of proposed response
performance_levels: Response is vague or not actionable
Response is somewhat specific but missing operational detail
Response is specific and actionable

rubric_dimensions.criterion: Quality of justification linking response to cause
performance_levels: Justification is absent or disconnected from causal analysis
Justification references cause but connection to response is weak
Justification clearly explains why response addresses identified cause
No trade-offs or constraints mentioned
Trade-offs mentioned but superficial or not relevant
Discusses relevant trade-offs showing evaluative judgment

scoring.mastery_rule: All three dimensions must reach highest level

assumption_notes: assumes learner has procedural knowledge of common response actions not explicitly taught
operational context is underspecified in brief, requiring learner to make reasonable assumptions
does not assess ability to execute the proposed response or monitor its effectiveness

assessments.capability_claim: Learner can perform the complete workflow of interpreting signals, diagnosing causes, and proposing responses to model degradation

required_evidence.criterion: Correctly interprets degradation signals from a novel monitoring dashboard
required_evidence.rationale: Demonstrates objective obj-model-monitoring-001 in integrated context

required_evidence.criterion: Performs causal analysis that differentiates among multiple plausible causes with evidence-based reasoning
required_evidence.rationale: Demonstrates objective obj-model-monitoring-002 in integrated context

required_evidence.criterion: Proposes a justified response action with consideration of trade-offs
required_evidence.rationale: Demonstrates objective obj-model-monitoring-003 in integrated context

required_evidence.criterion: Maintains coherence across interpretation, diagnosis, and response phases
required_evidence.rationale: Demonstrates integration of all three objectives as a unified capability

task.description: You are presented with a monitoring dashboard for a production ML model showing recent performance data. Interpret the signals present, diagnose the most likely cause of any degradation, and propose a specific response action. Provide your complete reasoning from observation through recommendation.
conditions: dashboard is novel and distinct from formative assessment fixtures
degradation pattern is realistic and consistent with known operational scenarios
learner completes all phases in sequence without intermediate feedback

performance_levels: Misses critical signals or misinterprets signal nature
Identifies main signals with minor gaps or imprecision
Accurately identifies and describes all relevant signals
Diagnosis is missing, incorrect, or unsupported
Diagnosis is plausible but reasoning is incomplete or weakly supported
Diagnosis is well-reasoned with clear evidence linking signals to causes
Response is inappropriate, vague, or not justified
Response is reasonable but justification or trade-off consideration is weak
Response is specific, well-justified, and shows evaluative judgment
Phases are disconnected or contradictory
Phases are loosely connected with some inconsistencies
Clear logical flow from signals through diagnosis to response

scoring.mastery_rule: All four dimensions must reach highest level

assumption_notes: assumes realistic monitoring dashboard fixture can be created with sufficient fidelity
assumes 30-minute time limit is reasonable for complete workflow
this assessment duplicates coverage of individual objectives but provides integration evidence
scoring requires expert judgment; inter-rater reliability should be established

prerequisites.capability: Navigate and read time-series metrics displayed on a monitoring dashboard interface
prerequisites.rationale: Objective obj-model-monitoring-001 requires interpreting signals from a dashboard; learner must be able to read charts, identify trends, and understand metric visualizations before interpreting degradation patterns.

prerequisites.capability: Recognize common ML model performance metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, latency, throughput, error rate)
prerequisites.rationale: Assessment assess-model-monitoring-001 requires using 'appropriate terminology' to describe signals; learner must know what metrics represent before identifying degradation patterns in them.

prerequisites.capability: Understand what constitutes degradation in ML model performance (e.g., accuracy decline, latency increase, drift)
prerequisites.rationale: Objective obj-model-monitoring-001 assumes 'common degradation signals include metrics like accuracy, latency, throughput, error rate, and drift' but does not teach these concepts; learner must understand degradation before identifying it.

prerequisites.capability: Reason about cause-and-effect relationships in technical systems
prerequisites.rationale: Objective obj-model-monitoring-002 and assessment assess-model-monitoring-002 require differentiating causes and connecting signal patterns to causal mechanisms; general causal reasoning ability is foundational to this analytical task.

prerequisites.capability: Understand basic architecture of ML systems in production (model, data pipeline, serving infrastructure)
prerequisites.rationale: Assessment assess-model-monitoring-002 assumes 'learner has conceptual knowledge of common degradation causes not explicitly taught' such as data drift, infrastructure changes, upstream service issues; understanding system architecture is necessary to reason about these causes.

prerequisites.capability: Recognize common operational response actions for ML systems (retraining, rollback, alerting, pipeline investigation)
prerequisites.rationale: Objective obj-model-monitoring-003 assumes 'learner has awareness of common response actions' and assessment assess-model-monitoring-003 assumes 'learner has procedural knowledge of common response actions not explicitly taught'; learner must know what actions exist before proposing one.

prerequisites.capability: Consider trade-offs and constraints when evaluating technical decisions
prerequisites.rationale: Assessment assess-model-monitoring-003 requires acknowledging trade-offs or constraints; learner must have general ability to think about competing concerns before applying it to model degradation response.

sequencing_rationale: Module 1 teaches signal interpretation first because objectives 002 and 003 both list obj-model-monitoring-001 as a prerequisite
Module 2 follows Module 1 because causal diagnosis requires interpreted signals as input per objective conditions
Module 3 follows Module 2 because response planning requires both interpreted signals and differentiated causes per objective conditions and prerequisite chain
Linear sequence matches the workflow: observe → diagnose → respond
All modules are required; no branching paths exist in the three-objective chain

assumption_notes: No lesson content provided in input artifacts; lesson_ids arrays are empty
Module time estimates divide the 60-minute brief constraint equally across three objectives
Course includes all seven candidate prerequisites identified in input; no teaching objectives exist to satisfy them within this brief
Sequencing assumes synchronous linear progression; does not consider interleaved or mastery-based paths
Module titles are model-proposed and not validated against organizational naming conventions
